name: Glorious | Hotlanta
description: The high will come rolling in as soon as you exhale, gently cascading over both mind and body with a deep sense of relaxation and ease. You'll feel your body settling further and further into the couch, filled with a heavy sense that locks you straight down. As your body settles, your mind will be lifted into a stoney state of euphoria that puts a smile on your face before knocking you flat out with a heavy sedation.
